narrative.overview: A clean portfolio with a portrait-led introduction, black and gray dark canvas, neutral accents, native Apple-inspired typography, and selective frosted surfaces. On wide screens, identity and actions sit left, the supplied homepage portrait occupies the center, and professional background sits right. Concise about and skills highlights lead to the featured project below. Dark is the first-visit default; light preserves content, layout, and interactions.
dos: Keep colors and glass material bound to shared theme variables.
Keep homepage highlights concise and use dedicated pages for full details.
Preserve equivalent content and layout in both themes.
Respect reduced motion and reduced transparency.
Label pending project details and unavailable contacts honestly.
donts: Do not invent qualifications, outcomes, or resume destinations.
Avoid skill percentages, excessive gradients, and decorative motion.
